name: Goi ca map
summary: A shark salad, one of the island dishes that is hard to find elsewhere in Vietnam.
howToEat: Order it as a salad with the seafood meal, and ask whether the kitchen has it that night.
seoTitle: Goi ca map — shark salad in Con Dao
seoDescription: Gỏi cá mập is the shark salad Côn Đảo is known for, a dish hard to find elsewhere in Vietnam.
